answer.value: Two open-source evaluation frameworks were used: Microsoft's Eureka ML Insights for internal development benchmarks/ablations (MathVista, MMMU-CoT, ScreenSpot/ScreenSpot-V2, ScreenSpot-Pro, V*Bench) and VLMEvalKit for standardized community benchmarks (e.g., AI2D TEST split, ChartQA TEST split, DocVQA VAL split, MathVerse/MathVision/MathVista MINI splits, MMMU DEV_VAL split, OCRBench, ScreenSpot-V2, etc.). Results were also reported with forced nothink and forced thinking modes. Shots and prompt settings are not stated; evaluation logs will be released publicly.
quotes: Two evaluation frameworks were used: Microsoft's Eureka ML Insights for internal development benchmarks, and VLMEvalKit for standardized community benchmarks. Evaluation logs will be released publicly.
